page: Amazon Web Services m8ib.4xlarge is an x86_64 general purpose instance built on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor. The server utilizes an Intel processor running at 3.9 GHz, providing 16 dedicated virtual CPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core. System memory is configured at 64.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory proportion of 4.0 GB per virtual core. Hardware acceleration is not present on this machine, with a GPU count of zero.

The instance contains no bundled local storage, requiring workloads to rely exclusively on remote network storage volumes for persistence and operating system installations. Networking infrastructure supplies a baseline bandwidth of 17 Gbps for inter-service communication and storage connectivity. The instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which necessitates private VPC routing or explicit allocation of networking resources.

With its balanced compute and memory distribution, the m8ib.4xlarge provides a predictable density profile for workloads that do not require high-speed ephemeral NVMe disks. The hardware configuration is appropriate for running enterprise application tiers, mid-sized relational database engines, microservices nodes, batch data processing tasks, and containerized backend workloads.
